long_biography.plain_text:
With early financial backing from his parents, Vítek entered business after 1989, first importing consumer goods and then investing through Slovakia's voucher privatization. Cash generated from selling acquired company interests helped finance Czech property purchases when prices were still low. He turned an investment fund into the platform that became Czech Property Investments, initially expanding through residential and retail assets.

His decisive international step came in 2014, when he contributed CPI to the German GSG group and became the combined company's controlling shareholder. The business subsequently broadened across offices, retail, housing and hotels in Central Europe and Berlin. Vítek later left CPIPG's board and no longer runs daily operations; his current connection is as founder and primary shareholder through family trusts.
